verdict.rationale: Canny mentions 'Autopilot' capturing feedback automatically, suggesting some built-in AI automation, but the bulk of Canny's AI story (canny-docs-3/4/5/9) is about connecting Canny to EXTERNAL AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor) via MCP — the reverse of a built-in assistant inside Canny that users delegate tasks to. Missing for 10: a documented in-app AI assistant/chat interface within Canny's own UI, details on how Autopilot works or is invoked, and evidence users can conversationally delegate multi-step tasks to it.
